notes:
Top-line: Ochre QueryWorks builds a support orchestration layer for mid-market SaaS apps. They want to run a RAG-backed agent-assist product to: 1) surface cited answers from multiple knowledge sources (Zendesk, Confluence, internal S3 buckets), 2) provide one-click tool-calls from the agent UI (create/update ticket, escalate to L2, attach KB link), and 3) auto-summarize long ticket threads for TL;DR and quality checks.

Requirements / asks (from VP Support + Platform):
- Citation-first answers: must return a short answer + 1-3 citations with stable anchors. Precise snippet location preferred.
- Freshness window: ingest delta updates nightly; support TTL and per-source freshness metadata.
- Multi-source retrieval: blend signals from Zendesk (tickets), Confluence (KB), product docs in S3, and code comments (search). Need weighting control by source and recency.
- Spike resilience: baseline 200 live agents, target burst handling to 800 concurrent agent prompts for sales/campaigns with 95th p95 latency target <= 200ms for composer suggestions and <= 800ms for full RAG responses under peak.
- Tool-calling: REST hooks in agent UI to create ticket, attach snippet, trigger webhook to internal CRM. Must support idempotency keys and retry semantics.
- Security: Okta SSO (SAML), enterprise KMS, audit logs per request, retention controls (1 year default, configurable). Data residency: US-EAST required for production.
- Model controls: ability to pin model versions, policy-driven fallback to smaller cheaper model when capacity constrained, quantization recommendations for on-prem worker nodes.
- Evaluation metrics for POC: citation precision >= 90%, answer F1 >= 0.85 on internal eval set, average handle-time reduction >= 20%.

POC plan (3 weeks):
- Week 1: connectors + ingest (Zendesk + Confluence + S3), baseline retrieval config.
- Week 2: relevance tuning, evals vs annotated prompt set, implement citation formatting and source anchors.
- Week 3: spike tests (concurrency up to 800), latency validation, tool-call flows and failure injection.

Quotes / call notes: "We need citations we can point to in audit reviews — snippets, not hallucinations." — VP Support.
"If this reduces AHT even 15-20% we can justify the spend, but security must be airtight." — Head of Platform.

Current stance: prefers to iterate on Redwood hosted API for POC, but wants roadmap and timeline for Private/VPC deployment for production. Security team flagged data residency and KMS; procurement needs ARR estimate before procurement review.

Stubs/links: drive pricing deck, security QA doc attached; Fireflies transcripts above. Jira ticket RWD-3121 for ingestion failure case during test.
notes_summary: Evaluation-stage mid-market support orchestration company. POC focused on RAG across Zendesk+Confluence+S3, citation precision, freshness, tool-calling, and reliability under bursts. Security (Okta, KMS, US-EAST residency) is gating; POC success metrics defined. Next: kickoff POC and finish security questionnaire.
